name: Urijah
overview: The name Urijah appears in Scripture as belonging to several individuals who served God faithfully in different capacities. One was a priest during King Ahaz's reign, likely the same Uriah who witnessed Isaiah's prophecy, emphasizing the role of godly witnesses in times of national crisis. Another Urijah was a priest assisting Ezra during the post-exilic restoration, highlighting faithful service in the reestablishment of true worship. Additionally, Urijah the prophet boldly proclaimed God's judgment against Judah in Jeremiah's time, ultimately facing persecution and death for his obedience, demonstrating the cost of prophetic faithfulness.
